title: Cross-Backend QIEO: Universal Runtime Portability across OpenMP5, CUDA, HIP, and Multi-Language Interfaces
summary: Quantum-inspired algorithms emulate quantum mechanical principles, such as, superposition, interference, and probabilistic amplitude evolution, on classical hardware by representing candidate solutions as qubit vectors and evolving them through rotation-gate operators. This approach offers higher optimization performance without physical qubits, and has been shown to achieve order-of-magnitude speedups (10--80$\times$) over traditional solvers on combinatorial, high-dimensional NP-hard problems.
